subject: English
description: Voice change, Degree of comparison, Simple-Complex-Compound, Affirmative-Negative transformation.
exam_tip: Always write the full transformed sentence clearly maintaining the original tense.

items.question: Do the work at once. (Passive)
items.answer: Let the work be done at once.

items.question: He pleases us all. (Passive)
items.answer: We all are pleased with him.

items.question: Who wrote the book Hamlet? (Passive)
items.answer: By whom was the book Hamlet written?

items.question: The police arrested the thief. (Passive)
items.answer: The thief was arrested (by the police).

items.question: A storm destroyed the village. (Passive)
items.answer: The village was destroyed by a storm.

items.question: They are playing football in the field. (Passive)
items.answer: Football is being played in the field by them.

items.question: He had completed the project before deadline. (Passive)
items.answer: The project had been completed by him before deadline.

items.question: Never tell a lie. (Passive)
items.answer: Let not a lie ever be told.

items.question: We must respect our teachers. (Passive)
items.answer: Our teachers must be respected by us.

items.question: Smoke filled the hall. (Passive)
items.answer: The hall was filled with smoke.

items.question: His conduct shocked me. (Passive)
items.answer: I was shocked at his conduct.

items.question: Rice sells cheap. (Passive)
items.answer: Rice is cheap when it is sold.

items.question: The flower smells sweet. (Passive)
items.answer: The flower is sweet when it is smelt.

items.question: Panic seized the crowd. (Passive)
items.answer: The crowd was seized with panic.

items.question: Someone has stolen my pen. (Passive)
items.answer: My pen has been stolen.

items.question: I know him well. (Passive)
items.answer: He is well known to me.

items.question: People speak English all over the world. (Passive)
items.answer: English is spoken all over the world.

items.question: Write a letter to your mother. (Passive)
items.answer: Let a letter be written to your mother.

items.question: Did you see the accident? (Passive)
items.answer: Was the accident seen by you?

items.question: One should keep one's promise. (Passive)
items.answer: A promise should be kept.

items.question: Man is mortal. (Negative)
items.answer: No man is immortal. / Man cannot but die.

items.question: Only Allah can help us. (Negative)
items.answer: None but Allah can help us.

items.question: He has only a few books. (Negative)
items.answer: He has not many books.

items.question: Every mother loves her child. (Negative)
items.answer: There is no mother but loves her child.

items.question: As soon as the thief saw the police, he fled. (Negative)
items.answer: No sooner had the thief seen the police than he fled.
items.rule: As soon as → No sooner had ... than

items.question: He is too weak to walk. (Negative)
items.answer: He is so weak that he cannot walk.

items.question: I must do the work. (Negative)
items.answer: I cannot but do the work. / I cannot help doing the work.

items.question: He is both honest and hardworking. (Negative)
items.answer: He is not only honest but also hardworking.
items.rule: Both ... and → Not only ... but also

items.question: Where there is smoke, there is fire. (Negative)
items.answer: There is no smoke without fire.

items.question: Always speak the truth. (Negative)
items.answer: Never tell a lie.

items.question: Akbar was the greatest emperor of India. (Positive)
items.answer: No other emperor of India was as great as Akbar.

items.question: Akbar was the greatest emperor of India. (Comparative)
items.answer: Akbar was greater than all other emperors of India.

items.question: Iron is the most useful metal. (Positive)
items.answer: No other metal is as useful as iron.

items.question: He is as strong as a lion. (Comparative)
items.answer: A lion is not stronger than he.

items.question: Dhaka is larger than all other cities in Bangladesh. (Superlative)
items.answer: Dhaka is the largest city in Bangladesh.

items.question: Gold is more precious than silver. (Positive)
items.answer: Silver is not so precious as gold.

items.question: Cox's Bazar is the longest sea beach in the world. (Positive)
items.answer: No other sea beach in the world is as long as Cox's Bazar.

items.question: Though he is poor, he is honest. (Simple)
items.answer: In spite of his poverty, he is honest.
items.rule: Complex to Simple (Though → In spite of)

items.question: Though he is poor, he is honest. (Compound)
items.answer: He is poor, but he is honest.

items.question: Since the weather was foul, we stayed at home. (Simple)
items.answer: The weather being foul, we stayed at home.

items.question: Work hard and you will succeed. (Complex)
items.answer: If you work hard, you will succeed.

items.question: Work hard or you will fail. (Complex)
items.answer: Unless you work hard, you will fail. / If you do not work hard, you will fail.

items.question: Going to market, he bought a shirt. (Compound)
items.answer: He went to market and bought a shirt.

items.question: I saw a bird which was flying in the sky. (Simple)
items.answer: I saw a bird flying in the sky.

items.question: He confessed that he was guilty. (Simple)
items.answer: He confessed his guilt.

items.question: Honey tastes sweet. (Passive)
items.answer: Honey is sweet when it is tasted.

items.question: They elected him captain. (Passive)
items.answer: He was elected captain by them.

items.question: I saw him play cricket. (Passive)
items.answer: He was seen to play cricket by me.

items.question: He told me that he would come. (Passive)
items.answer: I was told by him that he would come.

items.question: We should not tease the poor. (Passive)
items.answer: The poor should not be teased by us.

items.question: Post the letter. (Passive)
items.answer: Let the letter be posted.

items.question: Help the helpless. (Passive)
items.answer: Let the helpless be helped.

items.question: Do not make a noise. (Passive)
items.answer: Let not a noise be made.

items.question: Who called you? (Passive)
items.answer: By whom were you called?

items.question: What do you want? (Passive)
items.answer: What is wanted by you?

items.question: He made me drive the car. (Passive)
items.answer: I was made to drive the car by him.

items.question: He is known to all. (Active)
items.answer: All know him.

items.question: The work will be finished by tomorrow. (Active)
items.answer: We / They will finish the work by tomorrow.

items.question: He is too proud to learn. (Complex)
items.answer: He is so proud that he cannot learn.

items.question: Only graduation is required. (Negative)
items.answer: Nothing but graduation is required.

items.question: As soon as we reached the station, the train left. (Negative)
items.answer: No sooner had we reached the station than the train left.
items.rule: As soon as → No sooner had

items.question: Every cloud has a silver lining. (Negative)
items.answer: There is no cloud without a silver lining.

items.question: He is the wisest man in the village. (Comparative)
items.answer: He is wiser than any other man in the village.

items.question: He is the wisest man in the village. (Positive)
items.answer: No other man in the village is as wise as he.

items.question: A plane flies faster than birds. (Positive)
items.answer: Birds do not fly as fast as a plane.

items.question: Prevention is better than cure. (Positive)
items.answer: Cure is not so good as prevention.

items.question: In spite of being wealthy, he is unhappy. (Compound)
items.answer: He is wealthy, but he is unhappy.

items.question: Besides being intelligent, he is industrious. (Compound)
items.answer: He is not only intelligent but also industrious.

items.question: Taking his bag, he left the room. (Compound)
items.answer: He took his bag and left the room.

items.question: I know his birthplace. (Complex)
items.answer: I know where he was born.

items.question: Tell me the truth. (Complex)
items.answer: Tell me what the truth is.

items.question: He worked hard so that he could pass. (Simple)
items.answer: He worked hard to pass / in order to pass.

items.question: If you do not hurry, you will miss the train. (Compound)
items.answer: Hurry up or you will miss the train.

items.question: Speak the truth or you will be punished. (Complex)
items.answer: Unless you speak the truth, you will be punished.

items.question: He bought a pen which was red. (Simple)
items.answer: He bought a red pen.
